remarks: A rare offering in Coto de Caza’s coveted Los Ranchos Estates, this extraordinary equestrian estate spans approximately three acres, pairing a fully renovated 8,400-square-foot residence with exceptional grounds, resort-style amenities, and a private equestrian compound. Encompassing seven bedrooms across a five-bedroom main residence, a one-bedroom guest house, and a one-bedroom barn residence, the estate offers remarkable versatility for refined living, entertaining, and an equestrian lifestyle.
